name: ARA4052
title: CPU reference renderer misuse
summary: The CPU reference renderer was used out of order (draw before begin, missing texture) or with invalid dimensions or clips.
html:
The CPU reference renderer was used out of order (draw before begin, missing texture) or with invalid dimensions or clips.

#Common causes

  • A test reads pixels before rendering a frame.

#Fixes

  • Begin a frame, upload textures, draw, then read pixels.

  • Code: ARA4052

  • Constant: ui::REFERENCE

  • Reported by: ara-ui-render
